blocks.text: SAN FERNANDO, Bukidnon — A municipal outreach team hiked for six hours through slippery mountain trails to deliver school supplies, slippers, and hot meals to 110 pupils from Indigenous Peoples (IP) communities in two remote hinterland schools in this town. The beneficiaries—composed of Tigwahanon, Matigsalug, and Manobo learners—are enrolled at Sil-angon Mission School in Sitio Sil-angon and Pandarasdasan Mission School in Sitio Pandarasdasan, both in Barangay Magkalungay. The two schools operate as hinterland satellite campuses of Magkalungay Elementary School under the Department of Education’s San Fernando II District, serving mountain communities where pupils previously had to trek for hours to reach […]...
